When did it start and end, how long was it, did we keep our monthly availability target, and why did it happen? Record it in {WS}/result.json: start, end, minutes_down, availability_june_pct, slo_999_ok, root_cause.
answers:
[g] Incident report for the June game-server outage into ./result.json.

[a] Scanned all three June logs for non-INFO lines (covers WARN/ERROR/FATAL for the whole month); the only incident is on 2026-06-02. Applied the README's rule: down = first save error to the `server ready` line. Computed duration and availability with a short python script and wrote result.json.

[r]
- Start: 2026-06-02 03:17:42, first `ERROR SaveGame failed ... No space left on device`
- End: 2026-06-02 03:53:31, `INFO server ready, accepting players`
- minutes_down: 35.82 (exactly 2149 s = 35 min 49 s)
- availability_june_pct: 99.917 (43200 June minutes minus 35.82)
- slo_999_ok: true (99.917 ≥ 99.9)
- root_cause: `/data` disk full (97% / 3.1 GB free warned at 03:10) → autosave ENOSPC → server unresponsive → watchdog restart loop (exit 137) until backup rotation freed 38.2 GB at 03:52:20.

Assumptions: June = 30 days = 43200 minutes; only the one incident per README; timestamps are local, same clock throughout; minutes_down rounded to 2 decimals, availability to 3.

Evidence: log lines gameserver-2026-06-02.log:251 (start), :294 (end), :241 (disk warn), :292 (backup rotation freed 38.2 GB); the non-INFO grep over all three files shows no other ERROR/FATAL incident in June (the 06-01 RCON auth failure is unrelated and non-fatal). Python output confirms 2149 s, 99.91709%, ≥99.9 true.

[n] Nothing open; result.json is final. No browser or app windows were opened.
